build_channel_mapper: build a ChannelMapper to reduce or increase backbone feature channels across multiple scales
create_channel_mapper_forward: create a forward pass through ChannelMapper to transform multi-scale feature maps to uniform channels
test_ChannelMapper: test the ChannelMapper class by passing multi-scale tensors and verifying output channel dimensions
review_ChannelMapper_init: review the ChannelMapper constructor to understand conv layer configuration and extra convs logic
summarize_ChannelMapper: summarize the ChannelMapper class used to map backbone feature channels to a uniform output size
